caption: three plot threads, one evil monkey - stewie's scheming carries the show's humor to the ps2.
about: Family guy video game! (2006) splits the show's humor across three playable threads: stewie's platforming revenge on bertram, peter's bone-crushing beat-em-up of random cutaway violence, and brian's stealth against the evil monkey. The cutaway joke structure translates better than critics of the time admitted - the voice cast is the real cast, and the writing is the real writing.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
